common_language: The word for the app's display language (Settings, Language picker).
common_cancel: Cancel button in dialogs and forms.
common_remove: Remove button (takes an item off a list).
common_ok: OK button that acknowledges a dialog.
common_confirm: Confirm button in a confirmation dialog.
common_done: Done button that closes a finished step.
common_apply: Apply button for filters and settings.
common_reset: Reset button for filters and forms.
common_refresh: Refresh button or tooltip that reloads data.
common_retry: Retry action on an error message.
common_tryAgain: Try Again button on a failed screen or load.
common_undo: Undo action after something was moved to Trash.
common_details: Details action on an error message (shows the technical text) and Details dialog title.
common_viewDetails: View Details button or menu item.
common_clear: Clear button (empties a field or filter).
common_optional: Marks a form field that may be left empty.
common_all: The no-filter choice in a filter list.
error_generic: Second line of an error message when nothing more specific is known (FriendlyError).
error_noPermission: Second line of an error message: permission denied (FriendlyError).
error_noConnection: Hakuna mtandao. Angalia intaneti yako kisha ujaribu tena.
Second line of an error message: no network (FriendlyError, sign-in).
error_tooSlow: Imechukua muda mrefu mno. Jaribu tena.
Second line of an error message: timed out (FriendlyError).
error_notFound: Second line of an error message: the record was deleted (FriendlyError).
error_alreadyExists: Second line of an error message: a duplicate (FriendlyError).
error_rateLimited: Maombi ni mengi mno. Subiri kidogo kisha ujaribu tena.
Second line of an error message: rate limited (FriendlyError).
login_wrongCredentials: Barua pepe au nenosiri si sahihi.
Sign-in error for a wrong password OR an unknown email (one message on purpose, so it does not reveal which emails are registered).
login_accountDisabled: Akaunti hii imezimwa. Wasiliana na msimamizi wako.
Sign-in error: the account was disabled.
login_tooManyAttempts: Umejaribu mara nyingi mno. Subiri kidogo kisha ujaribu tena.
Sign-in error: too many failed attempts.
login_signInFailed: Sign-in error when Firebase gives no message of its own.
common_facility: The word Facility, as a fallback name when a facility has none.
common_hideDetails: Hides the technical text shown by Details.
dateRange_title: Title of the custom date range dialog (Payments, Transactions).
dateRange_start: Label above the start date in the date range dialog.
dateRange_end: Label above the end date in the date range dialog.
error_couldNotLoad: Heading of the error shown when a list fails to load (FirestoreErrorView).
error_indexNeeded: Ukurasa huu unahitaji faharasa ya hifadhidata itengenezwe mara moja kwanza.
Error shown when a Firestore query needs an index (FirestoreErrorView).
error_createIndex: Button that opens Firebase Console to create a missing index (FirestoreErrorView).
error_createIndexHint: Hii inafungua Firebase Console ikiwa na faharasa inayohitajika tayari imejazwa.
Small text under Create Missing Index (FirestoreErrorView).
maintenance_defaultMessage: Tunafanya matengenezo yaliyopangwa kwa sasa. Tafadhali jaribu tena baada ya muda mfupi.
Maintenance screen text when the platform admin set no message of their own.
time_justNow: Age of a notification under one minute.
time_minutesAgo: Age of a notification in minutes (short form).
time_hoursAgo: Age of a notification in hours (short form).
time_daysAgo: Age of a notification in days (short form).
payments_method: Label above the payment method chips.
products_categoriesHeading: Upper-case heading of the categories list in the product catalog side panel.
products_stockStatusHeading: Upper-case heading of the stock status list in the product catalog side panel.
products_allProducts: Row that shows every product (product catalog side panel).
products_statusAll: Stock status filter: no filter (product catalog side panel).
products_statusReorderSoon: Stock status filter: should be reordered soon.
products_statusExpired: Stock status filter: past its expiry date.
summary_trendNew: Badge on a summary card when there was nothing in the previous period to compare with.
loading_accountTitle: Title of the full loading screen after sign-in.
loading_accountSubtitle: Inaandaa taarifa na huduma za kituo chako
Second line of the full loading screen after sign-in.
facilities_settingUp: Shown while the dashboard opens for a chosen facility.
facilities_yourFacility: Stands for the facility name in "Setting up ..." when it has none.
subscription_expiredTitle: Title of the dialog shown when a locked facility tries to record a sale or service.
subscription_expiredAssistant: Usajili wa kituo hiki umekwisha, kwa hiyo mauzo na huduma mpya haziwezi kurekodiwa kwa sasa. Bado unaweza kuona taarifa zote zilizopo. Tafadhali muombe msimamizi wako ahuishe usajili.
Subscription Expired dialog text for an assistant.
subscription_expiredAdmin: Usajili wako umekwisha, kwa hiyo mauzo na huduma mpya haziwezi kurekodiwa kwa sasa. Bado unaweza kuona taarifa zako zote zilizopo. Tuma malipo ili kurejesha huduma kamili.
Subscription Expired dialog text for an admin.
subscription_goTo: Button in the Subscription Expired dialog (admins).
